summary: Recognizable ivory cottage massing, dark intersecting gables, dormer, and porch detailing are present, but the principal entrance is assigned to the wrong face and the key veranda is weakened.

orientation.summary: The located SV3 view establishes +v as the Pratt-facing show facade with the characteristic two-tier veranda; SV2 shows the Miller-facing -u end where the ground porch merely wraps around. The model’s door inventory contains only one door, on -u, and none on +v, turning the secondary Miller side into the sole/principal portal. Place a clear principal doorway on +v; retain any -u door only as secondary.

issues.problem: The sole modeled entrance is on -u rather than the Pratt-facing +v veranda facade evidenced by SV3.
issues.fix: Add the principal doorway within the +v veranda composition and make the -u opening secondary or remove it if unsupported.

issues.problem: The characteristic two-tier open veranda reads as a largely enclosed, flat lower porch, diminishing the building’s strongest identifying feature.
issues.fix: Emphasize two open stacked porch levels with slender posts, railings, decorative cornice trim, and a legible wrap onto -u.

issues.problem: The +u labeled face render is almost completely blocked by a roof surface, preventing review and indicating camera/model clipping.
issues.fix: Move the face camera beyond the building bounds and regenerate an unobstructed +u elevation view.
